author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices waiting for a surprise, finding C low and high, echoing short patterns and taking turns, using a bouncy old dance song.

classes.title: Wait for the pop!
classes.goal: Hear the whole song, crouch down low, and jump up on 'Pop!'.

mathTarget.parentLine: Guessing what comes next, then waiting for it

classes.parentPrompt: Crouch down together and wait; spring up with your arms high on 'Pop!'.
classes.childAction: Crouch and wait, then jump up when the song says Pop!
classes.bridge: The song winds up like a spring; Pop! is when it lets go.

intro.caption: Something pops at the end!
intro.parentCue: crouch down with your child and wait

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting for a surprise you can hear coming.

classes.title: Round the mulberry bush
classes.goal: Tap the big bouncy beat on any key while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: A bouncy beat that comes back again and again

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap the big beats, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key on each big bouncy beat.
classes.bridge: All a-round the mul-ber-ry: the taps skip round the bush.

intro.caption: Skip round the bush
intro.parentCue: bounce your child gently on each big beat

games.caption: All around, tap tap
games.parentCue: Say 'round and round' as you tap

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: tapping a steady bouncy beat.

classes.title: The weasel's hole, C
classes.goal: Find C, just left of the two black keys, and play it with one finger.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys as a sign to find C

classes.parentPrompt: Touch two black keys together, then slide your child's finger to the white key before them.
classes.childAction: Find two black keys, then press C like a button.
classes.bridge: Two black keys are the bush; C is the weasel's hole just left.

intro.caption: C hides left of the black keys
intro.parentCue: touch the two black keys, then slide left

games.caption: C, C, C, in the hole

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding C by the two black keys.

classes.title: Low C, high C
classes.goal: Find C in two places: a low C and a high C with the same name.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same note lives in a low house and a high house

classes.parentPrompt: Point to the low C, then the high C. Say 'monkey' low and 'weasel' high.
classes.childAction: Hop from the low C up to the high C and back.
classes.bridge: Every C sits left of two black keys; the weasel pops up to the high one.

intro.caption: Two Cs, two holes
intro.parentCue: point to the low C, then the high C

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the same note low and high.

classes.title: Monkey see, monkey do
classes.goal: Listen to short patterns of two or three notes and copy them back.

mathTarget.parentLine: Hearing a tiny tune and keeping it in mind to copy

classes.parentPrompt: Play or sing each pattern, pause, then nod to your child: 'Monkey, your turn.'
classes.childAction: Listen, then copy the notes like a cheeky monkey.
classes.bridge: The monkey copies the weasel: same keys, same order.

intro.caption: Monkey see, monkey do!
intro.parentCue: nod to your child for their turn

games.caption: Up we go: C, D, E
games.parentCue: Say 'up, up, up' as they play

games.caption: Up and back: E, G, E

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing short patterns and copying them back.

classes.title: Two and two
classes.goal: Echo notes that come in pairs: two Cs, then two Ds.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each note comes twice, like two shoes in a pair

classes.parentPrompt: Hold up two fingers for each pair and say 'two Cs, two Ds'.
classes.childAction: Echo two Cs, then two Ds. Show two fingers each time.
classes.bridge: Every note brings a twin: C, C, then D, D, like footprints.

intro.caption: Every note has a twin
intro.parentCue: hold up two fingers for each pair

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: noticing notes that come in pairs.

classes.title: Wait for the weasel's C
classes.goal: Wait and play C at the right moments while the grown-up plays the rest.

mathTarget.parentLine: I play my notes, you play yours: we take turns

classes.parentPrompt: Play your notes, then look at your child and nod just before each C.
classes.childAction: Finger ready on C. Play it when it lights up.
classes.bridge: The grown-up chases round the bush; you pop out on C.

intro.caption: You are the weasel's C
intro.parentCue: nod just before each C comes

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting for your turn and playing on time.

classes.title: Weasel C, monkey D
classes.goal: Play two special notes, C and D, and tell them apart by ear and by place.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sorting notes into two groups: C notes and D notes

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'C' or 'D' aloud before each one; cheer for every one your child catches.
classes.childAction: Play C or D when it lights. Two neighbours.
classes.bridge: C is left of the two black keys; D hides right between them.

intro.caption: Two notes: C and D
intro.parentCue: touch C, then D, and name each one

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling two notes apart by ear and place.

classes.title: The monkey and the weasel
classes.goal: Play the whole song together, sharing one steady bouncy beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players keeping the same steady beat

classes.parentPrompt: Keep the beat going even if a note is missed; smile and nod at each turn.
classes.childAction: Play your notes in time with your grown-up's beat.
classes.bridge: Monkey and weasel run round together, never too far apart.

intro.caption: Round and round together
intro.parentCue: sit close and keep the beat steady

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: sharing one beat and taking turns.

classes.title: Pop for teddy!
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy and save the biggest surprise for the pop.

mathTarget.parentLine: The song repeats, builds up, then ends with a pop

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play the high pop note, then cheer and bow.
classes.childAction: Play for teddy, shout Pop! at the end, then bow.
classes.bridge: Round, round, round the bush, then Pop! jumps up high to the right.

intro.caption: A song for teddy!
intro.parentCue: sit teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song with a surprise ending.
